notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds (basis recorded as cash); business-type funds are accrual (proprietary statement p7, Total column; measure net position), as FY2023/FY2024. Governmental statement lines from p5 Total Governmental Funds column; fund balances 2,277,278 -> 2,391,680 printed (2,277,278 + 3,372,206 - 3,237,306 - 20,498 = 2,391,680). Beginning cash not printed. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents' 1,700,152 (p4); certificates of deposit 671,181 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 20,347 (p4) is a separate printed line not added to ending_cash (as FY2023). Bond proceeds 988,000 printed among revenues -> receipt line (Bond Proceeds). Transfers: Total column prints (20,498) net out to Water 10,855 and Sewer 9,643 (p5, p7) -> transfers_out; business_type.transfers_net +20,498. Business-type totals are operating + nonoperating (computed); gain on disposal of assets 966 recorded as a receipt (Sale of Property). Business-type roll-forward 6,380,970 + 3,547,106 - 3,002,774 + 20,498 = 6,945,800. Proprietary cash flows (pp8-9) left null as in later years (not GAAP). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), governmental and business-type columns per line, totals from Total column; component unit (Wisner Care Center) excluded (its prepaid expenses and capital projects lines are component-unit only). governmental_net_position null (not GAAP). Detail: General Fund from the General Fund Departments combining statement (pp14-15), the more detailed schedule, so the General Fund budget schedule (p10) is not recorded; Street, Dinklage Foundation and Joint Fire budget schedules (pp11-13); Street 'Grants and contributions' actual is '-' (budget 20,000) and is not recorded. Utility fund statement columns not added to detail (as FY2023/FY2024). Other Governmental Fund (Cemetery Trust) has no schedule and is not in detail. Park 'Repairs and maintenance' printed as (68,894). Read pages 1-15 of 15
